Interface MediaExportJob

All Known Subinterfaces:
ExportJob
public interface MediaExportJob
Represents a single media export job, including its retained outcome after another export has started.

  • Method Details

    • progress

      MediaExportJob.Progress progress()
      Provides a thread-safe, non-blocking snapshot of the current export progress.
      Returns:
      the current MediaExportJob.Progress snapshot

    • result

      MediaExportJob.Result result()
      Returns the immutable terminal result of the export.

      Returns null while the export is still pending. The terminal result is retained indefinitely by this handle.

      Returns:
      the MediaExportJob.Result if completed, or null otherwise

    • cancel

      boolean cancel()
      Requests cancellation of the export job in a thread-safe manner.
      Returns:
      true if cancellation was successfully requested, or false if publication or completion has already begun

    • onComplete

      void onComplete(Consumer<MediaExportJob.Result> listener)
      Registers a listener to be invoked when the export job completes.

      Each registration runs once on the client thread after cleanup, even if registered late.

      Parameters:
      listener - the consumer to receive the final MediaExportJob.Result
